responsibilities.title: SEO implementation and performance
responsibilities.details: Manage SEO implementation and performance throughout the month to support numerical deliverables. Technical health is addressed through the monthly Technical SEO Audit & Fixes cycle; do not count ongoing checks as extra cycles.

deliverables.name: SEO Report
deliverables.details: Cover keyword performance, organic traffic, conversions, technical health, backlink progress, competitor/content-gap analysis, completed work, and next-month priorities.

responsibilities.title: Technical SEO monitoring & fixes
responsibilities.details: Monitor indexing and technical health, and implement fixes throughout the month. This is an ongoing responsibility, not an arbitrary monthly completion count.

responsibilities.title: Organic performance and conversion opportunities
responsibilities.details: Monitor organic performance and conversion opportunities throughout the month. Contribute observations to reporting and implementation.

responsibilities.title: LSA account, profile and verification monitoring
responsibilities.details: Monitor account and profile health and verification status; surface issues promptly.

responsibilities.title: Missed calls and lead quality
responsibilities.details: Monitor missed/answered calls and lead quality; dispute invalid leads as required.

responsibilities.title: Speed-to-lead and conversion monitoring
responsibilities.details: Monitor response speed and lead conversion; surface conversion blockers.

responsibilities.title: Campaign, spend and conversion monitoring
responsibilities.details: Review campaign performance, spend and conversions on the existing Monday/Friday rhythm. These checks support, but do not double, the supplied weekly numerical deliverables.

responsibilities.title: Keyword, targeting and ad-performance management
responsibilities.details: Manage keywords, targeting and ad performance; monitor search intent.

responsibilities.title: Waste reduction and issue response
responsibilities.details: Identify wasted spend, reduce waste, and respond to campaign or tracking issues as required.

responsibilities.title: Scheduling and publishing
responsibilities.details: Prepare and publish planned social content against the approved calendar.

responsibilities.title: Brand consistency and content quality
responsibilities.details: Maintain brand consistency across posts and perform content quality control.

responsibilities.title: Engagement and performance monitoring
responsibilities.details: Monitor engagement and performance; adjust content based on performance as required.
